'''Nishr Base Ten''' was one of several bases utilized by the [[Nishr Taskforce]] during the [[Nishr Campaign]]. It was a cave in the highlands surrounding the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison, and was used by the company to gather intelligence on the base, and to launch night raids on the weapons hardpoints.<ref name="ROE" />
